ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% low-intensity black pixels with <2% high-intensity white pixels localized to specific anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black field across both lobes; localized high-contrast white circular rings at [x:350, y:500] on the left lobe and a cluster of smaller white points near the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel amplitudes of peaks vary between 10-25 pixels, with the most jagged topography located on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve meeting a sharp convex leading edge at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive high-contrast white annular ring (approx. 30 pixels in diameter) on the medial left lobe; multiple smaller white circular clusters near the right lobe tip consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical high-contrast linear streaks visible on the lower-medial section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent annular scarring on left lobe; irregular jagged truncation/notch on the distal-most edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a single, highly isolated and well-defined white ring on the left lobe is a primary unique identifier.
